entry_policy: PROSPECTIVE ONLY. Base gate remains VERIFIED EXACT PAIR + TOKEN IDENTITY + liquidity >= $50K + H1 volume >= $15K + H1 transactions >= 50. New entries additionally use ANTI_CHASE_V1. Existing entry time/price are never rewritten.
truth_note: Persistent forward ledger. Entry price/time never change after creation. Current aggregate ROI is withheld unless every position has an identity-verified exact-pair mark or confirmed terminal zero. Legacy pair-only marks are quarantined, not silently valued.
important_limit: Paper execution only; fill price, slippage, gas, MEV and sell execution are not proven.

quality_delayed_rows.policy: ANTI_CHASE_V1: delay new entry when same-pair pre-entry run-up >25%; delay when liquidity <100K and H1 turnover >2x; quarantine extreme discovery/entry ratios. Hard liquidity floor remains 50K.
